messages:
matt: quick RFC follow-up: proposal to refactor enrichment path into two services: 'stager' (stateless prep + cache key gen) and 'executor' (stateful KV + model calls). want feedback on boundaries, fallbacks, and rollout.

anya: curious why not sidecar for KV/model? fewer network hops.

matt: considered sidecar. tradeoffs: sidecar reduces hops but increases per-pod memory and complicates lifecycle in Dedicated. separate services let us scale stager cheaply for light prep and scale executor for heavy model work.

kevin: can you sketch the minimal API so we can review error flows and payload sizes?

matt: sure, rough sketch:
POST /enrich/stage -> { staged_id, cache_key, preview }
POST /enrich/execute -> { staged_id, cache_key, model_hint } -> { enriched_output, cache_hit }
stager returns small payloads, executor owns heavy calls and KV writes.

ria: main concern is hotpath latency when execute is a cross-AZ call. recommendation: AZ-affinity routing, small local LRU on executor to avoid remote hits, and a "lite" fallback model for p95/99 when saturated.

matt: agree on routing and lite fallback. SLO targets proposed: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~150ms.

kevin: semantics question: do we need strong write-after-read guarantees? or eventual consistency with idempotency keys? also how to handle private/on-prem installs?

anya: most workloads can tolerate eventual consistency; use idempotency and causal keys. for private installs expose sidecar/local-cache mode behind a flag so data never leaves host.

matt: rollout phases: 1) behind FF deploy stager as proxy forwarding to old enrichment for safety; 2) deploy executor as separate service and enable for internal tenants + canary; 3) migrate tenant cohorts and monitor quality/latency; 4) remove monolith state and deprecate old code.

kevin: i'll draft routing policies, autoscale rules, and fallback config. aim EOD Wed.

ria: i'll own executor canary instrumentation + perf thresholds.

matt: i'll update the RFC with API contract, phased plan, and eval prompts. deploy-bot: canary started for enrichment-stager v0.1.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment kicked off: enrichment-stager v0.1 -> canary-3 :rocket: 

matt: action items: @kevin routing draft by EOD Wed, @ria executor canary plan by Fri, @matt RFC update. closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
